title: Summarize: a fast CLI that gives you the gist of any URL or file  #github
description:
Need to understand anything fast? Meet Summarize — a fast CLI that gives you the gist of any URL or file. Point it at a web article, a YouTube link, or even PDFs, images, audio, or video — local or remote — and it just works.
